cases.title: "Show me" demonstrates on the target pair only

rubric.reason: Before the first demo in Turn 2, the mentor called preview_frame at time 1, which falls inside Title's Position 0.5–1.5 s focus pair, and the reply says nothing wrong about the frame.

The only edit was one set_ease on demo_target (1/ADBE Transform Group/ADBE Position/1), and the turn ends with 'The other three are yours: Title's second Position move (1.5–3 s), its Scale and its Opacity. Ease them and say "done".'

Every name and time matches the snapshots: '10 keyframe pairs across 5 visible layers' adds up (9 visible linear plus Subtitle's partly_eased pair), Subtitle Opacity stopping hard at 1.3 s matches linear_end 'end', Title's four pairs and times are correct, and the icon change at the shared 1.5 s key is backed by the one-sided demo.

Turn 1 ends on the single layer question, and the Turn 2 demo turn gives one idea sentence about linear motion, then the demonstration with Edit > Undo, one 'look at' sentence, and a hand-back naming the three remaining pairs that ends on 'Ease them and say "done"', with no list or second walk-through.
Turn 2 calls preview_frame at time 1 on Title. That is inside the focus pair Position 0.5–1.5 s, and the reply makes no wrong claim about the frame.

The only edit is one set_ease on demo_target 1/ADBE Transform Group/ADBE Position/1. The turn ends with "The other three are yours: Title's second Position move from 1.5 s to 3 s, its Scale and its Opacity. Say "done" when you've eased them."

Every name and time matches the snapshot: Title Position 0.5–1.5 s and 1.5–3 s, Scale, Opacity, Subtitle Opacity linear at the end, Old Take hidden and Icon precomp. "10 pairs across 5 layers" including Subtitle adds up over the visible layers (Title 4 + Subtitle 1 + CTRL 1 + Bar 3 + Glow 1).

The opening gives the count, the proposal and the leave-outs as one choice and ends on the single Title question. The "show me" turn has one idea sentence about the linear move, the demo with Edit > Undo, one "look at" sentence, and a hand-back naming the three remaining pairs that ends on "say done".

In turn 2, before its first explanation and demo, the mentor calls preview_frame at time 1 on Title, which falls inside the focus pair Title › Position 0.5–1.5 s, and the reply does not describe the frame wrongly.

The only edit is one set_ease on demo_target (1/ADBE Transform Group/ADBE Position/1), and turn 2 ends by handing back the three named pairs: "Title's second Position move from 1.5 s to 3 s, its Scale and its Opacity. Say \"done\" when you've finished."

All names and times match the tool output: Title's Position 0.5–1.5 s and 1.5–3 s, Scale and Opacity 0.5–1.5 s, Subtitle Opacity partly eased with a linear end, Old Take hidden, and Icon a precomp; "11 keyframe pairs… over 6 layers" matches 10 linear plus 1 partly_eased across Title, Subtitle, CTRL, Bar, Glow and Old Take.

The opening gives the count, the Title proposal and the leave-outs, then ends on one question about the layer; the turn-2 'show me' reply has one idea sentence (constant speed then a hard stop is linear), then the demo, Edit > Undo, one 'Look at the two keys' sentence, and a one-sentence hand-back of the three remaining pairs.
